correctness.rationale: The homogeneous hyperbolic reduction is exact; the E4 reparameterization, endpoint expansions, boundary comparisons and compactness argument were rederived. The explicit mixed-sign witness has an exact rational logarithm certificate.

originality.rationale: The 2010 primary source explicitly leaves E4 open. Exact-formula, synonym, citation-chain and later generalized-Muirhead searches did not locate the sharp C(d) phase curve or the resulting E4 classification. Originality is to the best of our knowledge.

value.rationale: The result supplies a sharp necessary-and-sufficient phase boundary throughout the previously untreated region, identifies a complete globally positive subregion, and proves that every lower-d cross-section contains both global and mixed behavior.

disclaimer: Same-model review: passed. Independent audit: not yet performed.
